articles.title: At least three killed and dozens injured as Houthis strike Saudi airports
articles.summary: At least three people were killed and dozens injured by Houthi attacks on two of Saudi Arabia’s international airports, including in the capital, Riyadh. "On Tuesday and Wednesday... Abha International Airport and King Khalid International Airport were subjected to attacks targeting their facilities," the kingdom's civil aviation authority said in a statement on Wednesday. articles.title: Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed 82 Houthi military targets across Yemen
articles.summary: Saudi-led coalition's spokesperson Major-General Turki al-Maliki said 82 targets were destroyed in a “comprehensive operation” across Saada, Hodeidah, al-Jawf and Marib. In a statement posted on X, he said the targets included 11 mountain-based ballistic missile storage sites in Saada, as well as command and control centres, communications systems, missile and weapons depots, and a gathering site. https://t.co/O24LLoSHNY — المتحدث الرسمي باسم قوات التحالف (@CJFCSpox) October 7, 2026

articles.title: GCC chief condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi airports
articles.summary: Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) secretaryeneral Jassim Mohammed al-Budaiwi condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia’s Abha and King Khalid airports, describing them as “systematic crimes” targeting civilians. Targeting civilian airports and “endangering the lives of travellers, workers and civilians represents a dangerous escalation and a flagrant violation of international laws and norms", he said in a statement. Budaiwi also said that GCC countries stand united with Saudi Arabia.

articles.title: Houthis attack Aden airport as fighting intensifies in Yemen
articles.summary: Yemen's Houthis attacked Aden's international airport with ballistic missiles and explosive-laden drones on Wednesday, the country's Transport Ministry said, as fighting between the Iran-aligned group and Saudi-backed government forces intensified. Fighting has been focussed in recent days on areas around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a shipping route that has become more crucial for energy exports since the ​conflict between the ‌US and Iran restricted trade through the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Houthis atacam os aeroportos de Aden e Riad, apesar da contraofensiva governamental no Iêmen
articles.summary: A Arábia Saudita afirmou ter interceptado, nesta quarta-feira (7), mísseis lançados pelos houthis do Iêmen em direção a Riad. Os rebeldes também reivindicaram ataques contra o aeroporto da capital saudita e contra o aeroporto de Aden, enquanto as forças governamentais iemenitas, apoiadas pela Arábia Saudita, tentam recuperar territórios conquistados pelos houthis.
